title: Config
description:
Top-level coderef configuration. See `DESIGN.md` §7.2 / §7.3.

`IndexMap` is used in place of `HashMap` so that pattern declaration
order is preserved — relevant for tie-breaking when two patterns share
the same `priority` (DESIGN.md §5.5, §9.2).

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor autocomplete. Ignored by the engine.

ignore.description:
Gitignore-style globs to exclude from scanning, applied repo-wide.
See `DESIGN.md` §7.2.

patterns.description: Map of pattern id → pattern definition. See `DESIGN.md` §5, §10.

workspaceRoot.description: Override the auto-detected workspace root. Supports variables.

severity.description:
Workspace-level severity overrides for doctor checks.

Resolution order is: per-pattern `Pattern.severity[check_id]`,
then this map, then the check's hardcoded default. Use it to
suppress a check across every pattern in the repo (`{
"pattern.captureUnused": "off" }`), or escalate a check
globally (`{ "pattern.unused": "error" }`) without sprinkling
overrides on every pattern.

Pattern.description:
One reference pattern. See `DESIGN.md` §5.1, §5.3, §7.3.

Many fields are tagged for later versions; they are accepted by the
schema and stored on `Pattern` but not exercised by the v0.1 engine.

description.description:
Free-form description of what this pattern is for and when it
applies. Surfaces in `coderef patterns`, hover tooltips, and
doctor diagnostics that name the pattern. Optional but strongly
recommended for shared / template configs.

flags.description: Regex flags applied on top of the always-on `g` mode.

title.description: Hover / link title template. Supports variables.

priority.description:
Priority for tie-breaking overlapping matches. Default 0.
See `DESIGN.md` §5.5, §9.2.

scope.description: Scoping rules: where this pattern is applied.

verify.description: Shorthand verify toggle. Either a boolean or a full `VerifyToggle`.

severity.description:
Per-check severity overrides. Keys are check names; values are
`Severity`. See `DESIGN.md` §5.4.3, §9.1.

label.description:
Compat-form marker spelling for the `IfChange`/`ThenChange`
surface (DESIGN §10.3). When set on at least one
`kind: "ifchange"` pattern, the parser additionally recognises
the configured `open.regex` and `close.regex` as labelled-region
markers alongside the canonical `IfChange`/`ThenChange` (and the
global `Label`/`EndLabel` from #54). Useful for codebases
mirroring `ebrevdo/ifttt-lint` or other coupled-change tools
that use different keywords.

PatternKind.description:
Reference kinds. See `DESIGN.md` §5.2.

v0.1 implements `Url` and `Local`. `Block` (DESIGN §5.2.1, v0.2) is
the "marker must not be present" kind used for `DO NOT COMMIT` /
`DO NOT MERGE` style guards. `IfChange` is accepted by the schema
so v0.2 configs parse, but the v0.1 engine rejects it during scan.
`Command` is reserved for the post-v0.4 backlog.

oneOf.description: Target is a workspace-relative path resolved via §6.

"Must not be present" marker. Every match is a failure surfaced
by `coderef check`; intended for `DO NOT COMMIT` / `DO NOT
MERGE` style guards. No target resolution; the matched text is
itself the diagnostic.

TargetSpec.description: One target in a multi-target pattern. See `DESIGN.md` §5.3.1 (v0.3).

label.description: Display label for the hover / "Open with…" picker.

priority.description: Priority; higher wins for primary. Default 0.

enabled.description: Whether verification runs at all. `None` means inherit defaults.

profile.description: Force a specific network profile for this verification.

required.description:
For multi-target patterns: whether this target must succeed for the
reference to be considered verified (v0.3).

ScopeConfig.description: Where a pattern is applied. See `DESIGN.md` §5.4.

include.description: Gitignore-style globs to include. Empty = include everything.

exclude.description: Gitignore-style globs to exclude. Empty = no extra exclusions.

commentsOnly.description: If true, only match inside detected comment regions. See §5.4.1.

prefix.description: Full prefix policy (v0.2; §5.4.2). Accepted for forward compat.

anyOf.description:
`true` — pattern scans commit messages. `false` — pattern does
NOT scan commit messages.

`"required"` — every commit message must contain at least one
match of this pattern. Missing matches are reported as a
`commitMessageMissing` diagnostic on the pattern.

CommitMessageTag.description:
String tag for `CommitMessageScope::Tag`. Single-variant enum so
serde can distinguish it from `Bool` in the untagged form.

oneOf.description: `"required"` — pattern must match every commit message.

ActionsConfig.description:
Per-pattern action overrides (open / preview / verify).
See `DESIGN.md` §5.3.

ActionConfig.description:
One action. The full set of fields is accepted by the schema so v0.2+
configs parse; the v0.1 engine consumes only `kind` and `url`.

root.description: Search root; defaults to `${workspaceFolder}`. Supports variables.

extensions.description: File extensions to try when the literal path doesn't resolve.

indexFiles.description: Index file names to try when the candidate is a directory.

anchor.description: Capture template for the anchor name (e.g. `${anchor}`).

slugifier.description:
Markdown slugifier (v0.2; §6.3.2). Free-form to allow custom
configuration objects without locking the schema now.

oneOf.description: Both `/path` and `path` anchor at workspace root.

Honour the filesystem (insensitive on macOS default + Windows,
sensitive on Linux).

Severity.description:
Severity for a doctor check or pattern outcome.

Order is significant: a `max` over a set of severities is meaningful —
`Off < Hint < Info < Warning < Error`.

oneOf.description: The check is disabled; produces no diagnostic.
Worth noting but not a defect.
Likely a defect; surfaces in reports.

LabelConfig.description:
Per-pattern compat-form marker spellings (DESIGN §10.3).

Both `open` and `close` are required if `label` is set; the
parser validates this at config load via the
`pattern.labelCompatMissing` doctor diagnostic.

open.description:
Open-marker regex (e.g. `r"\bLabel\((?<id>[^)]*)\)"` or
`r"\bBEGIN_BLOCK\((?<id>[^)]*)\)"`). The `id` named group, if
present, supplies the block's label name; without it the
matched block is anonymous (Shape A only).

close.description:
Close-marker regex (e.g. `r"\bEndLabel\b"`,
`r"\bEND_BLOCK\b"`). Close markers don't carry an id —
pairing is positional (next open ↔ next close).

regex.description:
`fancy-regex`-compatible marker regex. The parser compiles it
at scan time; an invalid regex surfaces via the
`pattern.labelRegexInvalid` doctor diagnostic.
